title: Split setup_dns_blocker.sh under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring the DNS blocker setup script under the cap. It is the ExecStart of the live dns-blocklist-refresh.service unit, so the unit path and the script's exported function set must be unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The entry script and all three new libs are at most 250 lines.

Sourcing the script yields exactly the same 74 function names as before, diffed against a detached worktree at HEAD. The script exposes SETUP_DNS_BLOCKER_SKIP_MAIN, so this can be checked without running main().
systemctl cat dns-blocklist-refresh.service still resolves to the script, and the script still parses.
Every seam falls on a function boundary, outside the seven heredocs.
The pre-commit shellcheck hook passes on every file, with no new suppression.
out_of_scope: Running main(); it installs dnsmasq, writes systemd units and changes firewall rules on the live machine.
verifier: SETUP_DNS_BLOCKER_SKIP_MAIN=1 source + `declare -F`, diffed against the same from a worktree at HEAD; plus systemctl cat and bash -n on the unit's ExecStart; plus pre-commit run --files and check_file_length.sh.
